description:
Hello everyone,

I am new to the game Starsector and as I started playing it, I thought if the illustrations were animated, the game would feel even better. So I decided to work on creating a mod that will do just that.

Below is a showcasing of how it currently looks in my game and I am looking for feedback and also if this is something worth pursuing, since there are 99 image illustrations in the game to work on total.
